name: ALEX RIVERA

Senior Product Manager  |  AI-assisted Products and Workflows  |  B2B SaaS

summaries.text: Product manager with seven years in B2B SaaS and connected devices. At Brightgrid I took a grid-analytics product from pilot to 40 paying utilities; at Parcelpoint I owned carrier integrations used by 1,200 shippers. I work closest to engineers and operations teams, and I judge results by adoption and revenue.

Product manager who ships AI-assisted features into operational software. At Brightgrid I launched anomaly alerts that cut false call-outs by a third; at Parcelpoint I owned the integrations layer 1,200 shippers depend on. Seven years in B2B SaaS, working directly with engineers.

prototype internal tools with Claude and Cursor before asking engineering to build them.
